Barcode Generator

Generate barcodes in common formats — CODE128, CODE39, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC and ITF-14 — and download them as PNG or SVG images.

Retail formats are strict: EAN-13 needs 12–13 digits, EAN-8 needs 7–8, UPC needs 11–12, ITF-14 needs 13–14. CODE128 accepts letters and symbols too.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the value you want to encode.
  2. Choose a barcode format from the dropdown.
  3. Click Generate Barcode to preview it.
  4. Download the result as PNG or SVG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which barcode format should I choose?

CODE128 is the most flexible: it encodes letters, numbers and symbols of any length. Use it unless a retailer specifically requires an EAN or UPC code.

Why does the generator reject my number?

EAN-13 and UPC codes are strict retail formats. EAN-13 needs exactly 12 or 13 digits, EAN-8 needs 7 or 8, UPC needs 11 or 12. CODE128 has no such restriction.

Are the generated barcodes free to use commercially?

Yes — the codes are generated in your browser and are free to use. Real retail product codes must be registered with GS1 to be scannable in stores.
